content: Parallel to the rescue sector, the security equipment market is experiencing significant transformation driven by the integration of digital technologies and AI. The physical security market, which forms the backbone of global infrastructure protection, was valued at 158.1 billion USD in 2025 and is projected to experience steady growth, reaching 169.1 billion USD by 2026 [18] . This expansion is fueled by robust demand across residential, commercial, and industrial sectors [18] . Concurrently, the electronic security market, which encompasses critical systems such as video surveillance, access control, and intrusion detection, was forecasted to reach 77.7 billion USD in 2026 [20] . The drivers for this electronic segment include rapid global urbanization, the proliferation of smart home initiatives, and heightened security concerns across international borders [20] .
